details.name: Codec extensions (malware)
details.who: All Firefox users who have installed any of these add-ons.
details.why: The set of extensions labeled as Codec, Codec-M, Codec-C and other names are malware being distributed as genuine add-ons. If you think an add-on you installed was incorrectly blocked and the block dialog pointed you to this page, please comment on this blog post.
